name: Patrón Omega
source:
The world where the Omega Pattern story happens is apparently normal, similar to the one we live in. However, genetics and fate offer the possibility to a few individuals to born with a kind of Pattern or special brain signal which lets them to develop unique and different psychic skills that are determined by their life experiences which form the behavior and character.

From the shadows, an organization known as Bioagora moves the threads to subject the world according to its own interests thanks to the power and influences that they get, in part, with their Agents. These Agents are people who own the Pattern and were persuaded, bought or even forced and captured against their will in order to be brainwashed and indoctrinated so they can faithfully serve the Bioagora.

Shaiel (21 years old), a man who possesses the Pattern, has found himself obligated to live in the secrecy in order to avoid falling into the hands of the Bioagora. However, as time passes by, it gets more difficult to scape from a power which increases exponentially. Seeking for allies has become a vital task, and it seems that the only alternative available are the Celtas; a small and vaguely organized group with unorthodox methods whose pretension of facing the Agents and restoring an order different to the Bioagora’s seems a utopia.

As the rest of the population stay impassive in a gray world, Shaiel will have Shaiel to play his cards and find out the truth hidden by the Bioagora, the Celtas and himself.
translation:
欧米茄图案故事发生的世界显然是正常的，与我们生活的世界相似。然而，遗传和命运为少数人提供了一种可能性，即他们出生时就带有一种图案或特殊的大脑信号，使他们能够发展出独特的、不同的心灵技能，这些技能是由他们的生活经历决定的，这些技能形成了行为和性格。

一个名为Bioagora的组织在暗处根据自己的利益控制世界，这要归功于他们通过其特工获得的权力和影响力。这些特工是拥有模式的人，他们被说服、收买，甚至违背自己的意愿被强迫和俘虏，以便被洗脑和灌输，以便他们能够忠实地为Bioagora服务。

沙伊尔（Shaiel，21岁）是一名拥有图案的人，他发现自己有义务生活在秘密中，以避免落入Bioagora的手中。然而，随着时间的流逝，摆脱呈指数级增长的力量变得越来越困难。寻找盟友已成为一项重要任务，而塞尔塔斯似乎是唯一的选择。一个小而组织模糊的团体，采用非正统的方法，他们声称要面对特工并恢复与比奥阿戈拉不同的秩序，这似乎是一个乌托邦。

当其他人在灰色世界中保持冷漠时，谢尔将让谢尔发挥他的作用，找出比奥阿戈拉、塞尔塔人和他自己隐藏的真相。
